name: atelier
description: Atelier — the operating model for working with Claude as a teammate, distributed as an installable plugin. This repo is both the plugin and its own marketplace.

plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Apex honesty doctrine; six skills (session onramp, the peer-review lifecycle, queue-run orchestration, repo-scaffolding to the house standard, fleet-sweep health runs and review-drain budget runs); and four commands (a hand-run scan with four of the floor's scanners — secret / leak / licence / link — the pre-commit hook installer, worktree and fleet-pin). A named worked example — adopt it by becoming the principal.
